programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: The Revenger
programme.desc: This direct sequel is better than the original, minus Wang Tao. In this flick, Chin Hu (Gold Fox) (Hwang Jang Lee), learns of his brother's death and then swears revenge. Chin Hu cannot take his revenge against Shen Yi Wei due to the Government deploying him to a faraway place in China, so he decides to knock off his kid brother, Shen Ying Wu. Hsiao Yi Fei (John Liu) returns in time to help Ying Wu fend off Chin Hu and his crew's attempts to eliminate Ying Wu.

Chin Hu cannot take his revenge against Shen Yi Wei due to the Government deploying him to a faraway place in China, so he decides to knock off his kid brother, Shen Ying Wu. Hsiao Yi Fei (John Liu) returns in time to help Ying Wu fend off Chin Hu and his crew's attempts to eliminate Ying Wu.
